FX-DOF-001.says: As added: Focal Plane 0, so every depth is out of focus by its whole distance, fully; the whole picture at the full radius 10, edges repeated.

FX-DOF-002.says: Focal Plane 6, radius 3: the diagonal at depth 6 sharp, the near top left fully blurred, the far bottom right about half.

FX-DOF-003.says: Focal Plane 6, Thickness 4: everything from 4 to 8 sharp.

FX-DOF-004.says: Focal Plane 6, Bias 100: out of focus twice as fast.

FX-DOF-005.says: Focal Plane 6, Bias 25: half as fast.

FX-DOF-006.says: Bias 0: nothing leaves focus, the picture unchanged.

FX-DOF-009.says: Focal Plane keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 13 at frame 4: the sharp band moves from near to far.

FX-DOF-010.says: Maximum Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4.

FX-DOF-011.says: The depth written negative, Focal Plane -6: FX-DOF-002.

FX-DOF-013.says: Infinities and not-a-number in the depth: each read as D-348 reads it, all three fully out of focus; the warning every frame.

FX-DOF-014.says: Blender's layout, the depth in ViewLayer.Depth.Z and the colour in ViewLayer.Combined: FX-DOF-002.

FX-DOF-015.says: A file with no depth: unchanged, the warning every frame.

FX-DOF-016.says: On a PNG drawing: unchanged, the warning.

FX-DOF-017.says: On a solid: unchanged, the warning.

FX-DOF-018.says: On an adjustment layer above the EXR: no file of its own, unchanged, the warning.

FX-DOF-019.says: The layer moved 2 right and 1 down: FX-DOF-002 moved.

FX-DOF-020.says: An Exposure of +1 before it: the brighter picture blurred.

FX-DOF-022.says: Focal Plane 13, radius 3, Thickness 2: the far corner sharp, the near side fully blurred.

FX-DOF-023.says: Maximum Radius 201, above 200. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DOF-024.says: Maximum Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DOF-025.says: Focal Bias 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DOF-026.says: Focal Plane Thickness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-DOF-027.says: Focal Plane keyed to 2,000,000 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
